persos.desc: mother-in-law in her 60s, plum-and-crimson kaftan, glasses, holding ONE single baby wrapped in a blanket
persos.pose: sitting on the sofa in the foreground on the left, the baby in her arms, moved

persos.desc: son-in-law in his 30s, cobalt-and-navy shirt, short beard
persos.pose: standing on the right, hands in his pockets, relaxed

dialogue: Mon gendre, tu as donné mon nom au bébé-là ? Tu m'aimes vraiment dêh !
Belle-maman, maintenant je peux crier « Pélagie, tais-toi ! » chaque jour dêh.
jeu: Nobody walks; both stay in their places for the whole video. The mother-in-law, turned three-quarters to the camera, holds the baby tenderly and speaks with emotion. The son-in-law smiles widely and answers happily, his face clearly visible.
chute: The mother-in-law's tender smile slowly disappears and her eyes narrow. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the touched mother-in-law's offended face looking into the camera.
gag_legende: BELLE-MAMAN EN CHANGEANT LE PRÉNOM :
mecanisme: hommage retourné : le cadeau cache une vengeance
